title: Snail dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='38' ry='6' fill='#3a2b5a'/>
  <!-- snail body/foot -->
  <path d='M14 82 Q10 72 22 70 L72 68 Q88 70 86 82 Q84 90 68 90 L26 90 Q12 90 14 82 Z' fill='#8fe36a'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <path d='M20 78 Q22 72 30 71 L70 69 Q80 70 80 76' fill='none' stroke='#c8ff9e' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- shell -->
  <circle cx='55' cy='52' r='24' fill='#ff9e3d'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='52' r='24' fill='none' stroke='#ffd08a' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- shell spiral -->
  <path d='M55 52 Q63 46 67 54 Q70 64 58 68 Q44 71 40 58 Q37 44 52 38 Q70 32 76 48' fill='none' stroke='#c25a10' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- shell shine -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='42' r='5' fill='#ffe0b0'/>
  <!-- dancing arm (left) raised up -->
  <path d='M28 74 Q18 64 16 52' fill='none' stroke='#8fe36a' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='50' r='5' fill='#b8ff8a'/>
  <!-- dancing arm (right) raised up -->
  <path d='M64 70 Q74 58 80 46' fill='none' stroke='#8fe36a' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='44' r='5' fill='#b8ff8a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='60' r='11' fill='#8fe36a'/>
  <!-- eye stalks -->
  <path d='M18 52 Q16 42 14 38' fill='none' stroke='#8fe36a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M26 52 Q28 42 32 38' fill='none' stroke='#8fe36a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='37' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='37' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='37' r='2' fill='#3a2b5a'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='37' r='2' fill='#3a2b5a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M17 65 Q22 70 27 65' fill='none' stroke='#3a7a28' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- musical notes floating -->
  <g fill='#ffd23d'>
    <circle cx='72' cy='26' r='4'/>
    <rect x='75' y='12' width='2.5' height='15' fill='#ffd23d'/>
    <path d='M75 12 Q83 14 83 20 Q80 17 75 17 Z' fill='#ffd23d'/>
  </g>
  <g fill='#7fe6ff'>
    <circle cx='90' cy='34' r='3.5'/>
    <rect x='92.5' y='22' width='2' height='13' fill='#7fe6ff'/>
    <path d='M92.5 22 Q99 24 99 29 Q96 26 92.5 26 Z' fill='#7fe6ff'/>
  </g>
</svg>
